criteria_results.text: While a desktop-originated chat is open on mobile, new desktop user and assistant turns appear automatically without a manual refresh.
criteria_results.notes: The user confirmed mobile-originated turns and responses appeared live on desktop, but a message typed on desktop did not appear on mobile until the mobile transcript was manually refreshed.

failure_output: User: mobile messages into desktop originated messages and responses show up live on desktop - but when I type a message on desktop, it does not stream live to mobile, i need to refresh to see it update.
suggested_follow_up: Extend issue #1287 with a bidirectional live-update contract that drives a desktop-originated turn through the real engine event stream and asserts the already-open mobile transcript refreshes without user action.
